item.text:
{"brief":"The user enjoys teen movies for their light-hearted blend of comedy, romance, and the best parts of being young. They often rewatch teen movies they love.

One of their favorites is 10 Things I Hate About You. They praise its acting, writing, and casting across the board, plus an interesting storyline that they feel has more depth than a typical teen movie because of its Shakespeare basis. They enjoy its focus on romantic relationships, plentiful comedy, and how well the story flows.

They did not like Superbad very much, particularly after its hype as a great teen film. They acknowledge some funny lines but felt most had already appeared in commercials. They found it overly juvenile, simplistic, and generally not that funny, describing its portrayal as resembling adults’ assumptions about what teens do. They have never rewatched it and have no plans to.

They have heard of High School Musical and love singing and dancing. They expect those elements would probably entertain them, but did not confirm having watched the film or express an overall opinion of it."}
